jurisdiction: Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman
key_requirements: GDPR applies: lawful basis, data subject rights, breach notification
enforcement_authority: Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman (Tietosuojavaltuutetun toimisto)
research_exemption: Legal basis for scientific/historical research and statistics (s. 4(1)(3)); derogations from data subject rights with safeguards, DPIA or code of conduct for special data (s. 31)
genetic_data: GDPR art. 9 special category; special-category data may be processed for scientific research (s. 6(1)(7)); genomic data under separate Genome Center legislation
